title: Smoke detectors.
officialText: Appropriate safeties shall be provided so that detection of smoke or heat within the generator or equipment room shall prevent additional fuel oil from being pumped into the piping system within such room, including a fusible link operated valve in the supply pipe at the wall of the generator or equipment room.
